scenes.title: The quiet race for power
scenes.narration: There is a race happening right now, and most people cannot see it.
It is happening here, in buildings with no windows.
Every answer an AI gives you is paid for in electricity.

scenes.label: more energy than a web search
scenes.narration: A single AI answer can use many times the energy of a normal search.

scenes.headline: Power is the new bottleneck.
scenes.narration: Chips were the bottleneck. Now it is power.

scenes.headline: Follow the energy.
scenes.narration: If you want to know who wins, follow the energy.
